name: snapshot_A
how: make -C <clone> fc-snapshot as root under the arm's FC_CACHE_TYPE, FREEZE and FC_IO_ENGINE: as boot 7's cold_boot_<n> (boot to ssh, dockerd, compose up, HealthCheck done, the freeze, the pause, snapshot/create, the end line's cache_type, io_engine and frozen), snapshot.json (extra/fc-snapshot-A.json), and what the arm asked

name: baseline_A
how: laug baseline lab8-A-load while the cell is still leased (the guest path): its exit (3 when the window is under 300 s) and whether it read the guest

name: drive_A
how: GET /vm/config on the cell's socket as root: the rootfs drive's cache_type and io_engine, each against the arm's knobs (verify: v1.17 swagger; that a load keeps the snapshot's io_engine)

name: cell_A
how: the arm's cold lease on its -min 0 -max 1 pool, a create: id, block, the lease's labels, its create line (up, reflink, load and resume, ssh, the clock, cache_type, the thaw), the lease's seconds less create's (health and the 2 s poll)

name: load_A
how: laug load -duration 5m -rate 20 -max-concurrent 50 -run-id lab8-A-load on the arm's lease: its exit and run JSON's keys

name: vmm_A

name: threads_A
how: the VMM's threads every 100 ms beside the load (extra/fc-threads-A.jsonl): per comm group (firecracker, the event loop's thread; fc_api; fc_vcpu; iou-wrk under Async; other) the share of samples in D, with a wchan or stack naming fsync or the block layer, in D and so, the CPU and run-queue shares from schedstat; the achieved interval

name: verdict_A
how: laug verdict lab8-A-load -json: verdict, exit, window_s, deciding (the keys of lab1-v1310-1.verdict.json)

name: warmup_A
how: laug fault persistence-latency -run-id raun-lab8-A-warmup on the arm's lease, after 120 s idle (a warm-up, never counted, never cited): raun.jq, its backend, cache_type and the before window's end-to-end p95, over 50 ms share and persistence p99; run to its end whatever it reads

name: fc_image_sums

name: fc_image
how: make -C <clone> fc-image as root: exit, seconds, fc-lib.sh's pins, build-image.sh's version line, its built in N s, its guest host key line (the key type)

name: ladder_a
how: rung a (a file on the host's root ext4 under FC_DIR): dd if=/dev/zero bs=4096 count=1000 oflag=dsync, pass 1 a fresh file, pass 2 the same file with conv=notrunc; sync, then /proc/diskstats before and after each: per role writes, ms writing, flushes (column 19) and ms flushing (column 20), ms a flush

name: ladder_b
how: rung b (a file on the XFS loop volume FC_DISKS): dd if=/dev/zero bs=4096 count=1000 oflag=dsync, pass 1 a fresh file, pass 2 the same file with conv=notrunc; sync, then /proc/diskstats before and after each: per role writes, ms writing, flushes (column 19) and ms flushing (column 20), ms a flush

name: ladder_c
how: rung c (a reflink copy of golden.ext4 on FC_DISKS, written in place at the first shared extent of 1000 blocks or more (seek_block, and the transcript's writes in place at line)): dd if=/dev/zero bs=4096 count=1000 oflag=dsync, pass 1 a fresh file, pass 2 the same file with conv=notrunc; sync, then /proc/diskstats before and after each: per role writes, ms writing, flushes (column 19) and ms flushing (column 20), ms a flush

name: ladder_d
how: rung d, in the leased cell's guest (B: Writeback, not frozen) over the lease's ssh: dd of 1000 dsync 4 KiB writes to /var/tmp, pass 1 a fresh file, pass 2 conv=notrunc; vda's diskstats in the same session; before each pass the guest's own sync in a call of its own, then around the pass's call the host's root and loop lines and vmmetrics, the VMM's block_rootfs.flush_count summed; vmm_idle, the VMM's flushes over 15 s with nothing run before the rung (the cell's background rate, to set beside each pass); write_cache and the flush feature bit

name: ladder_e
how: rung e, in the leased cell's guest (A: Unsafe, frozen) over the lease's ssh: dd of 1000 dsync 4 KiB writes to /var/tmp, pass 1 a fresh file, pass 2 conv=notrunc; vda's diskstats in the same session; before each pass the guest's own sync in a call of its own, then around the pass's call the host's root and loop lines and vmmetrics, the VMM's block_rootfs.flush_count summed; vmm_idle, the VMM's flushes over 15 s with nothing run before the rung (the cell's background rate, to set beside each pass); write_cache and the flush feature bit

name: ladder_info
how: losetup -l -O NAME,DIO,LOG-SEC,RO of disks.xfs's loop (direct I/O, the logical sector size); its loop/dio; xfs_info of FC_DISKS (reflink, bsize, the log); stat %s %b %B of disks.xfs (sparse: blocks times their size under the apparent size); the root disk's and the loop's queue: scheduler, nr_requests, write_cache, logical_block_size, rotational
